        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

code='''def transform(grid):
    bg = grid[0][0]
    pts = [(i, j) for i, r in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(r) if v not in (bg, 0)]
    rs = [p[0] for p in pts]; cs = [p[1] for p in pts]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
    pat = [[grid[i][j] for j in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for i in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    pat = [row[::-1] for row in pat]
    zs = [(i, j) for i, r in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(r) if v == 0]
    zr = [p[0] for p in zs]; zc = [p[1] for p in zs]
    zr0, zc0 = min(zr), min(zc)
    out = [r[:] for r in grid]
    for i, row in enumerate(pat):
        for j, v in enumerate(row):
            out[zr0 + i][zc0 + j] = v
    return out
'''
